result_summary_contract_parts: Return exactly one non-empty JSON object with this shape: {"schema_version":"tonglingyu-upstream-bundle-v1","package_id":"...","source_scope_policy":{},"draft_candidate":{"draft_answer":"...","package_id":"...","claim_statements":[{"text":"...","evidence_refs":[...]}]},"coverage_assessment":{"status":"passed|partial|insufficient","missing_in_scope_slots":[],"out_of_scope_slots":[]},"evidence_hints":[],"retrieval_repair":{"recommended":false,"queries":[]},"out_of_scope_hints":[]}.

retrieval_repair.queries use full_text_search_request_v1 fields: query_text, search_terms, corpus_ids, source_layers, chapter_range, required_evidence_types, reason; no later-forty requests when later_forty_allowed=false.

Copy step_output_json.source_scope_policy exactly. Use only step_output_json evidence_brief, answer_requirements, question_frame_answer_requirements, entity_intro_answer_policy, and source_scope_policy; evidence_refs must come from step_output_json.evidence_ids.
Evidence with answer_use=supplemental_only may only be mentioned as supplementary clues and must not be the sole evidence_ref for a claim.

If answer_requirements.requested_evidence_type_anchors is non-empty, draft_answer and claim_statements must satisfy each anchor.required_cue_kind: source_or_text may use acceptable_anchor_cues, text must use text_anchor_cues. Generic source-layer labels or source titles alone are not enough when required_cue_kind=text.
If question_frame_answer_requirements.relation_open_object.must_mention_objects is non-empty, mention every listed object by acceptable_cues and include its source_cues or text_cue evidence.

If question_frame_answer_requirements.chapter_location is present, answer the chapter number first. If chapter_title is present, copy that exact chapter_title value or an exact distinctive cue from it into draft_answer and at least one claim_statement; do not paraphrase or invent chapter titles. Do not cite commentary unless the quoted commentary itself explains the chapter/title/location relation; prefer base-text or title evidence for plain chapter-location questions.

If entity_intro_answer_policy.applies=true, introduce the named entity from multiple readable in-package evidence cards when available; do not use a single short speech shell as the whole answer, and do not write package-external biography.
Commentary evidence is first-class in scope. If later_forty_allowed=false, ignore later-forty source layers.

For fate, ending, or interpretive questions, coverage_assessment.status=passed when the answer is bounded to source_scope_policy and states the evidence boundary; excluded later-forty is out_of_scope, not missing_in_scope. Use partial only when missing in-scope evidence prevents a bounded answer.

The visible draft_answer must be grounded in concrete retrieved evidence cues and must not expose internal terms such as package_id, trace_id, context_pack, claim_statements, or result_summary. Do not answer only with generic phrases such as 'some evidence' or 'related clues'.
Local reviewer remains authoritative. Do not add nested result_summary.
compact_result_summary_contract_parts: Return one upstream bundle JSON object with schema_version="tonglingyu-upstream-bundle-v1", package_id, source_scope_policy, draft_candidate{draft_answer,package_id,claim_statements{text,evidence_refs}}, coverage_assessment, evidence_hints, retrieval_repair, out_of_scope_hints.

retrieval_repair.queries use full_text_search_request_v1 fields: query_text, search_terms, corpus_ids, source_layers, chapter_range, required_evidence_types, reason; no later-forty requests when later_forty_allowed=false.

Copy source_scope_policy from step_output_json. Use only evidence_refs from step_output_json.evidence_ids. Evidence with answer_use=supplemental_only can only be supplementary and cannot be the sole evidence_ref for a claim.
Obey answer_requirements, question_frame_answer_requirements, entity_intro_answer_policy, and source_scope_policy.

For chapter-location questions, lead with the chapter number. When chapter_title is available, copy that exact title or exact title cue; do not paraphrase titles. Commentary is optional and must explain what it supports.
For entity_intro_answer_policy.applies=true, use multiple readable in-package evidence cards, avoid short speech shells and excluded public quote terms, and do not write package-external biography.

Commentary is first-class; ignore later-forty when disallowed. Use insufficient coverage only when constraints cannot be met. Do not expose package_id, trace_id, context ids, claim_statements, result_summary, or internal rule terms in draft_answer.

repair_context.required_action: return a full replacement upstream bundle that satisfies the same result_summary_contract
full_rules: keep the same package_id and source_scope_policy
fix only the rejected draft boundary
for chapter_location_title_cue_missing, copy step_output_json.question_frame_answer_requirements.chapter_location.chapter_title or one exact cue from it
if repair cannot satisfy the contract, set coverage_assessment.status to insufficient
compact_rules: use only package/evidence/source refs from step_output_json
for count questions, infer only from retrieved evidence and cite the supporting evidence_refs
for relation_open_object mention every must_mention object with source cue
if constraints cannot be met, return coverage status insufficient

draft_answer.repair_instruction: Fix the rejected draft without changing the evidence package boundary. Return only the replacement JSON object.

This is observation only; local reviewer enforcement remains authoritative. Do not add another result_summary key.
Return exactly one non-empty JSON object with this shape: {"evidence_observation":{"evidence_refs":[],"evidence_analysis":"short observation","unsupported_scope":"none|short boundary"}}.
step_output_json does not expose runtime evidence ids; keep evidence_refs empty. Do not write a final answer. Do not add another result_summary key.
Return exactly one non-empty JSON object with this shape: {"evidence_observation":{"commentary_refs":[],"commentary_analysis":"short observation","scope_notes":"short boundary"}}.

step_output_json does not expose runtime evidence ids; keep commentary_refs empty. Commentary is first-class evidence within the default pre-80 scope; later-forty material still requires explicit scope. Do not add another result_summary key.
Return exactly one non-empty JSON object with this shape: {"package_observation":{"package_id":"...","summary":"short observation"}}.
package_id must come from step_output_json; do not invent package ids. Do not add another result_summary key.
Return result_summary as a concise step observation that preserves the step output boundary.
